_comment: Synthetic /v3/model response (getModel -> ModelTable reads res.models). The prod read-only capture had no upload-model permission so it never returned /v3/model; this is hand-built to the consumed shape (id, name, sd_name_in_api, type.display_name, base_model, base_model_type, status). 3 representative private LoRA models: two status:1 (renders 'running') + one status:0 (renders 'unavailable'). No PII — all synthetic test data.
